title: Long runs (up to 200k steps): plateau, accuracy limit, convergence
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
split_source: experiments/E004_training_file_curve/config.json: N=30 -> train_pool_files[:30] (split E007-E009); N=210 -> all 210 train_pool_files (same set as E003 train_files); validation 45, test 45 (identical in E003/E004)

complex_one_hidden.note: best_e010 uses the lr chosen for architecture 'a' (equivalent to one hidden layer after merging)

real_tanh.note: WindowMLP tanh, Xavier normal, MSE loss (as E002/E005 real baseline); hidden 96 = 2x48 so that 2W*h + h^2 + 2h equals the dense part of complex_both; E010 has no real model, so best_e010 is skipped for it

lr_branches.best_e010: best stage1 config per architecture from experiments/E010_lr_schedule_study/results/stage1_selection.json; decay horizon = MAX_STEPS; skipped without error if the file is missing

optimizer: Adam, batch 1024; complex MSE for complex models, MSE for real_tanh

metrics.curves: validation and test BER reduction every 5000 steps (test for report only)
metrics.final: val/test reduction at the last step
metrics.best_by_val: test reduction at the validation-best evaluation
metrics.t98: first step whose validation reduction reaches 98% of the final value
metrics.y_inf: fit y = y_inf - a*steps^(-b) to the validation curve (steps >= 10000) with scipy.optimize.curve_fit; NaN if the fit fails
metrics.smoothed: rolling mean of the validation curve over a 10k window (3 points at 5k spacing, centred)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.plateau: improvement of the smoothed validation reduction over the last 50k steps < 0.2 p.p.
rule_draft.no_plateau: report 'plateau not reached within N steps'; y_inf only as a rough estimate
rule_draft.overfitting: a gap between N=30 and N=210 is interpreted as overfitting only if the N=30 validation curve falls (smoothed maximum - smoothed final > 0.2 p.p.) while the N=210 curve does not
